name: Annual Review of General Fund Commitments and Reserves
description: Finance Committee agenda item reviewing general fund commitments and reserves; any recommendations to change their level or planned use go to the full Board.

preparers.name: Director of Business Services or designee

deadline: As part of the annual budget development process
quote: On an annual basis, as part of the budget development process, the Director of Business Services or designee shall ensure that an item is included on the agenda of a Finance Committee meeting for the Finance Committee to review the District’s general fund commitments and reserves to determine whether they should be maintained, increased, or used for their designated and authorized purposes.
